lines.text: There's a giant rock on the hundred naira note. And some people see a face in it.
It's Zuma Rock, in Niger State, by the road into Abuja.
It towers about three hundred metres above the land around it.
That's why it's called the Gateway to Abuja.
And look closely: its dark streaks seem to form a human face.
Have you seen it in person? Tell me below, and follow Ijapa Tells!
